searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Keywords to search on Apple Podcasts (for example a topic, an industry or a show name). Each term is searched separately.

podcasts.title: Specific podcasts
podcasts.description: Optional. Apple Podcasts URLs (https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/name/id123456789), numeric Apple IDs (123456789) or RSS feed URLs (https://example.com/feed.xml).

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter Apple storefront country code (us, gb, de, kr ...).

maxPodcastsPerTerm.title: Max podcasts per search term
maxPodcastsPerTerm.description: Apple returns at most 200 shows per search.

maxEpisodes.title: Latest episodes per podcast
maxEpisodes.description: How many of the newest episodes to include on each item. 0 = none.

onlyWithEmail.title: Only podcasts with an email
onlyWithEmail.description: Keep only shows whose feed publishes an owner email.

activeWithinDays.title: Active within (days)
activeWithinDays.description: Optional. Keep only shows whose latest episode is newer than this many days.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: How many RSS feeds to fetch at the same time.
